data.title: This video introduces a local LLM selection system
data.content:
## Summary
This video introduces a local LLM selection system built with Ollama and LangChain that automatically routes user queries to the most appropriate installed model. By employing a 'selector' LLM to evaluate model descriptions, it eliminates the manual effort of switching between specialized tools like Code Llama or Mistral.

## Key Points
- Automating the selection of local LLMs based on task requirements to avoid manual switching
- Using a 'selector' LLM (Neural Chat) to evaluate query context against a dictionary of available models
- Implementing a modular system that supports coding, general chat, and uncensored tasks
- Providing both a terminal-based implementation and a Streamlit web UI
- Integrating Ollama for efficient local model management and rapid loading

## AI Concepts
LLM Routing, Model Orchestration, Local Inference, Agentic Workflows, Zero-shot Classification, Prompt Engineering
